provenance.source: Independent technical audit, log.txt entry 2026-10-24T15:49:34Z ('Independent technical audit of EXP-005 candidate and aca42dc baseline'). Probe inputs copied verbatim from the auditor's session scratchpad file probes.py (sha256 prefix f0de74da6d7db318), preserved on 2026-10-24 during EXP-006 Phase A.
provenance.note: The audit's F01-F13 numbering exists only in the auditor's chat report, which is not in the repository. Cases here keep the probe ids (P1-P4, T1-T3, I01-I17) and the defect titles the team lead gave in the EXP-006 instructions (F01, F02, F12, F13). Real-data regression ids are used only for regression checks, never in production code.
provenance.expected: What the auditor (and the official contract) say the behaviour should be.
provenance.observed_on_aca42dc: What the accepted baseline / production port actually does (measured 2026-10-24).
provenance.known_defect: true = observed differs from expected; the test is marked expectedFailure so it stays visible and turns into an unexpected success when fixed.
